articles.title: Can Your VP of Engineering Crash Your Sprint Retrospective?
articles.excerpt: A Slack message pops up an hour before your Sprint Retrospective. It is from the VP of Engineering. "Hey! I'd love to drop in on the Retro today just to listen and see how things are going." It sounds…
articles.body: A Slack message pops up an hour before your Sprint Retrospective. It is from the VP of Engineering. "Hey! I'd love to drop in on the Retro today just to listen and see how things are going." It sounds harmless. It sounds supportive. But as an Agile Coach and Technical Project Delivery Consultant, I have watched this exact scenario play out countless times. Allowing leadership to "just drop in" on a Retrospective is one of the fastest ways to destroy team trust. As Scrum Masters and Agile leaders, we face constant pressure from well-meaning managers wanting visibility into how the team operates. But a Sprint Retrospective is not a status meeting. It is not an executive showcase. It is a sacred space designed specifically for honest, unvarnished continuous improvement.
articles.author: Alireza Razmara

articles.body: Моє бінго на матч тримає всю гру в адресі сторінки. Картка — це чотирисимвольний код плюс бітова маска клітинок, які ти вже відмітив, тож посилання має вигляд #K7QM-1a2b . Воно переживає перезавантаження і навіть перехід із телефона на ноутбук. Як це влаштовано, я розповідав у попередній статті , і для футболу цього вистачало. Наступне бажання було передбачуване: хай люди пишуть власні події. Під Євробачення, під день народження. А раз картка вже живе в адресі, найлінивіший план — покласти туди ж і список подій. Цей план не пережив калькулятора. Адреса несе не літери Спершу я прикинув, що 35 подій дадуть посилання на 600–1000 символів. Довге, але його ж кидають у чат один раз і забувають. Тільки я рахував літери, а адреса несе байти, і події в мене українською.

articles.body: If you've been using AI tools to summarize text or generate code, you know the drill: you talk, the AI responds, and nothing happens unless you ask for it. But on October 21, 2026, Anthropic completely flipped that dynamic with the release of Claude Duet . Currently in a waitlisted research preview for Pro and Max users in the US, Claude Duet isn't just a chatbot—it is a proactive agent powered by Opus 5.5. It doesn't wait for your instructions. It monitors your work, builds out tasks on its own virtual machine, and then taps you on the shoulder when it needs your approval. Here is a breakdown of why this is Anthropic's answer to Meta's Muse, and how its architecture shifts us away from prompt-engineering into true autonomous delegation.

articles.title: How a Minecraft seed map predicts your world, and how to read one without getting misled
articles.excerpt: Disclosure: I built and run MCSeedLore, a browser-based seed map for Minecraft Java. It's an independent tool and isn't affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. A seed map looks like magic the first time…
articles.body: Disclosure: I built and run MCSeedLore , a browser-based seed map for Minecraft Java. It's an independent tool and isn't affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft. A seed map looks like magic the first time you use one. You paste a number, and a map of a world you've never opened shows up with villages, strongholds and slime chunks already marked. There's no trick to it, though, and once you see how it works it's much easier to tell when a marker deserves your trust and when it doesn't. This post covers the "how", then the practical side: correct input, finding structures, slime farms, and the limits that catch people out. The examples use MCSeedLore because I can speak for its internals, but the ideas apply to any seed map.

articles.title: WAV vs FLAC: How to Check Whether Smaller Files Contain the Same Audio
articles.excerpt: You have a finished audio file to store or hand over. FLAC can be smaller than WAV, but file size alone cannot tell you whether the exported audio stayed the same. A useful check compares the decoded…
articles.body: You have a finished audio file to store or hand over. FLAC can be smaller than WAV, but file size alone cannot tell you whether the exported audio stayed the same. A useful check compares the decoded samples in a common representation. I'm Alex from the Creatune team. I used the logged-out Creatune Audio Converter to export the same self-created six-second test tone as WAV and FLAC, then inspected both files with FFmpeg. This is a file and sample comparison, not a listening test or a claim about every possible input. What the two formats store A WAV container commonly carries uncompressed PCM audio. FLAC compresses audio losslessly: decoding a correctly encoded FLAC stream recovers the samples represented by that stream.

articles.body: Europe has dropped the ball on the prototype for its first reusable spacecraft. Or, rather, the prototype itself was dropped — on purpose — but the outcome of its fall was not what engineers had hoped for. The incident occurred during an Oct. 6 drop test of the full-scale Space Rider model , from the European Space Agency (ESA). The robotic vehicle's initial drogue parachute deployed successfully, but its main parafoil detached during deployment, leaving the prototype unable to slow its descent before crashing into the ground, according to ESA officials. The cause of the failure remains under investigation.

Hubble captured the image as part of a survey looking at 260 satellite galaxies around 22 Milky Way-like host galaxies within a radius of about 32 million light-years from Earth. Low-mass galaxies like the ones in this Hubble observing program provide a way to test the predictions of cosmological models on small scales, which struggle to match observations.

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 22, 1992: Ashes of 'Star Trek' creator Gene Roddenberry launch into space on NASA shuttle
articles.excerpt: On Oct. 22, 1992, the space shuttle Columbia launched into space with the ashes of Gene Roddenberry, the creator of "Star Trek." Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Oct. 22, 1992, the space shuttle Columbia launched into space with the ashes of Gene Roddenberry, the creator of " Star Trek ," aboard. During mission STS-52, NASA astronaut and shuttle commander James Wetherbee brought a small container with a portion of Roddenberry's ashes into space as part of his personal effects at the request of Roddenberry's widow, Majel Barrett . It was Roddenberry's lifelong dream to go to space, but he never got to go while he was alive. But thanks to his wife, a little bit of Roddenberry finally made it to space almost exactly one year after his death. NASA and his family didn't tell anyone about it until almost two years later in 1994. Wetherbee said he was "honored to be asked" by Barrett to carry Roddenberry's ashses on the spaceflight.

articles.title: After Starshield interruption, Ukraine wants to build its own satellite communication network with ICEYE and Nokia
articles.excerpt: Ukraine's military just signed a letter of intent with Nokia and the Finnish satellite maker ICEYE to look into developing a sovereign satellite-communication system for the war-torn nation.
articles.body: Ukraine wants its own satellite-communication system, which shouldn't be surprising given the events of the past week or so. The Ukrainian military just signed a letter of intent with two Finnish companies — the telecom giant Nokia and satellite maker ICEYE — to look into developing a sovereign satellite-communications network for Ukraine. "Ukraine needs secure, sovereign and high-performance satellite communications systems that it controls," ICEYE cofounder and CEO Rafal Modrzewski said in a statement today (Oct. 22). articles.title: The 2027 total solar eclipse will plunge these 10 ancient Egyptian temples and monuments into darkness
articles.excerpt: The "eclipse of the century" will plunge some of ancient Egypt's most spectacular sites into darkness on Aug. 2, 2027. These temples, tombs and monuments are inside the path of totality.
articles.body: The total solar eclipse on Aug. 2, 2027, has an ancient feel. It will certainly be a celestial event for the ages — at 6 minutes 23 seconds, it will feature the longest totality on land of the 21st century and the longest anywhere until 2114. However, its point of greatest eclipse occurs just a few miles from Thebes, the magnificent religious and political capital of ancient Egypt's Middle Kingdom and New Kingdom. On the east bank of the mighty Nile is Luxor, the great city of the living, with its massive temple complexes of Karnak and Luxor. On its west bank is the city of the dead, which includes the Valley of the Kings and the Temple of Hatshepsut.
